name: Cargo
description:
Cargo is GTM infrastructure for AI assistants. Connect this MCP server and Claude can operate your Cargo workspace: discover and run connector actions across 130+ integrations, execute tools and agents, query your CRM and revenue data models, and read the playbooks and context your team already wrote.

Sign in with OAuth — no API key to paste. Your session binds to one workspace, so Claude sees your integrations, your models, and your credits.

What you can do from chat:
• Search the action catalog and see credit cost before anything runs
• Enrich people and companies, look up CRM records, and call native platform ops
• Run a single action or a batch across many records (with cost sampling before large runs)
• Query workspace models with SQL-style selects, joins, and aggregates
• Read workspace context — ICP definitions, playbooks, rubrics — before guessing how your team works

Ask in plain English. Claude finds the right action, confirms cost when it matters, and brings results back into the conversation.

Best for RevOps, sales ops, and GTM engineers who already live in Claude and want the research-to-action loop without leaving the chat. Building multi-step workflows, warehouse-wide SQL, or workspace-as-code deploys stays in the Cargo CLI — this connector is the runtime for in-conversation work.

Learn more: https://www.getcargo.ai/mcp

_published_faq.name: How do I add Cargo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Cargo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.getcargo.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Cargo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cargo lists 17 MCP tools, including autocomplete_action, browse_context, describe_model, execute_action, execute_action_batch, get_action_schema, get_batch, get_run, get_usage, list_models, list_runs, and map_context.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Cargo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Cargo in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Cargo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Cargo is developed by Cargo. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
